text.description_html:
Laurey 57520, Nantucket Cabinet Pull in Matte Black

The Matte Black Nantucket Knot Cabinet Pull has the coastal grandma aesthetic; it is perfect for seaside homes and homes with nautical decor that want something fresh for this year. The Nantucket Cabinet Pull in Matte Black will contrast beautifully with white kitchen cabinets. It has a standard 3 inch center to center mounting and is 4.5 inches overall. The Laurey 57520 3 Inch Nantucket Pull in Matte Black comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57520 3 Inch Nantucket Pull in Matte Black:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available finishes:
Matte Black Satin Pewter Antique Pewter

Sold Individually
